tasks.label: Check it compiles (no signing)
tasks.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project AltmanMeter.xcodeproj -scheme AltmanMeter -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

tasks.label: Build and run
tasks.detail: Signed Release build, installed to /Applications (where widgets and login items work best), then opened.
tasks.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project AltmanMeter.xcodeproj -scheme AltmanMeter -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates build && (pkill -x AltmanMeter; sleep 1; rm -rf /Applications/AltmanMeter.app && ditto build/Build/Products/Release/AltmanMeter.app /Applications/AltmanMeter.app && /System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/LaunchServices.framework/Support/lsregister -u build/Build/Products/Release/AltmanMeter.app; open /Applications/AltmanMeter.app)
